GoatCounterAPITokenCredential.title: GoatCounter API Token
GoatCounterAPITokenCredential.x-credential-instructions: Supply an existing API token and one HTTPS site origin/site ID. Bearer HEADER plus Content-Type application/json, fixed /api/v0 only. The auth guide documents Bearer while Swagger declares basicAuth; this node has no Basic/query/body fallback, token issue or signup. Current code.goatcounter.com/cname are compared internally to the configured hostname; never followed. No /me (it returns token/user), decoded identity, account ownership or permission/entitlement claim.
